P_0x0046E4: A pilot of the Octopus Team. Carefree, optimistic, and loves gambling, calling himself a gambler. Easygoing but sharp-witted, with keen insight. Skilled with his hands, good at magic, but hopeless at sports. Rank: Ensign.
P_0x00486E: A pilot of the Octopus Team. From the Garstein family, a branch of the Bransteins; cousin to Rai and Elzam. Calm, proud, strong-willed, with a distant air. Puts on a brave front, so she is weak to sympathy. Seems capable at everything, but a poor cook. Rank: Ensign.
P_0x004A5C: Commander of the Octopus Team. Hot-blooded, combative, acts before thinking, defies orders. Her piloting skill is real, and she looks after her men well. Lieutenant.
P_0x004BA7: Pilot of the Octopus Team. Gentle and mild-mannered. Worried about Katinas tendency to run wild, she keeps her in check. She quietly supports others as the teams unsung pillar.
P_0x004CE0: Commander of the Steel Dragons, captain of the Hiryu Kai. Top of her class at the Icarus academy. Neat, worry-prone, easily moved to tears, yet firm at heart. Earnest despite being a rookie, she has won the crews trust. Named captain on Seans recommendation, she grows under his support. Promoted to Colonel after Shura Revolt.
P_0x004F77: Executive officer of the Hiryu Kai. A soft-spoken English gentleman whose knowledge and humor support Lefina well. Once exec officer on the Hiryu under Daitetsu. Meant to succeed him after damage to the Hiryu, he declined, naming Lefina instead. A drinker, liquor connoisseur. Promoted to Lt Col after Shura Revolt.
